exercises.title: US-11 on the backend: rule, service and API
exercises.problemHtml:
Code under test: src/rules/cancel.js, src/booking/myBookings.js, src/booking/service.js, src/api/myBookings.js — cancelDecision, startsAtVN, cancelMyBooking, listMyBookings, GET /api/bookings, POST /api/bookings/:id/cancel. It is the course's LabFlow Lite code at this point of the course; read it in the file tabs. Editing it changes nothing: the grader always uses the original.

Your task: Test US-11 without a database: the decision table of cancelDecision (owner, another student, a lecturer, an admin × active or cancelled × 60 or 59 minutes before the start, in Viet Nam time); the service on the in-memory repository (a cancelled slot can be booked again; two cancels at the same moment — exactly one wins); the API with Supertest (only my bookings in GET /api/bookings; 200, 404, 409, 422 for cancel, each response checked against openapi.json)..

⚠️ This exercise is not graded on the website — it starts the Express API as a Node HTTP server and calls it with Supertest, which a browser tab cannot provide. You run the same mutation check on your own machine with cham-tai-may.mjs (it is in the starter): your tests must pass on the correct code, then each of the 8 mutants (copies with one planted bug) must turn at least one test red, and the 1 harmless change must keep them green. Marking the exercise solved is self-reported.

The starter has a single smoke test (the code under test loads) — green, but it kills no mutant.

Requirements

  • Download the starter (⬇ Starter) and copy its files into your labflow-lite project — the one you have been building since lesson 0.2. It contains the test file to write (src/rules/cancel.test.js), the course version of the code under test, and cham-tai-may.mjs.
  • Write your tests in src/rules/cancel.test.js (more test files are fine: node cham-tai-may.mjs <file…>).
  • Run node cham-tai-may.mjs. It prints 9/9 when every mutant is killed and the harmless changes stay green.
  • Then press Self-mark as solved. The website cannot verify this — it is your own word.

⚠️ Bài này KHÔNG chấm trên website — nó dựng API Express thành server HTTP của Node rồi gọi bằng Supertest, điều mà một tab trình duyệt không làm được. exercises.solutionExplanationHtml:
The reference solution is the course’s own test file(s) for this lesson (src/rules/cancel.test.js, src/booking/myBookings.test.js, src/api/myBookings.test.js), checked to kill every mutant and to stay green on the harmless change(s). Each mutant changes exactly one decision:

  • M1 — admins are refused inside the last hour too
  • M2 — a lecturer can cancel anyone's booking
  • M3 — start read as UTC: cancelling stays open 7 hours too long
  • M4 — a cancelled booking inside the last hour says TOO_LATE, not ALREADY_CANCELLED
  • M5 — a cancelled slot stays blocked
  • M6 — two cancels at the same moment both succeed
  • M7 — My bookings shows everyone's bookings
  • M8 — too late answered as 409, not 422

Verified with the course checker on a fresh copy of LabFlow Lite. A suite kills a mutant only when some test observes that decision — which is why coverage alone does not tell you whether a suite is good.

exercises.title: US-11 on a real PostgreSQL
exercises.problemHtml:
Code under test: src/booking/pgRepo.js, db/schema.sql, src/api/myBookings.js — createPgRepo (findById, listByUser, cancel), db/schema.sql, the API on PostgreSQL. It is the course's LabFlow Lite code at this point of the course; read it in the file tabs. Editing it changes nothing: the grader always uses the original.

Your task: Test what only PostgreSQL 17 can show (needs Docker): listByUser gives back my rows in the API shape ("2026-11-16", "09:00") by date then start; two cancels at the same moment on two warm connections — one wins, one ALREADY_CANCELLED; a cancelled slot can be booked again while a live booking is still refused by the exclusion constraint; the API backed by PostgreSQL answers book → list → cancel inside openapi.json, and a cancel id of 2147483648 is a 404, never a database error..

⚠️ This exercise is not graded on the website — it needs a real PostgreSQL started in Docker by Testcontainers (integration config), which a browser tab cannot provide. You run the same mutation check on your own machine with cham-tai-may.mjs (it is in the starter): your tests must pass on the correct code, then each of the 6 mutants (copies with one planted bug) must turn at least one test red, and the 1 harmless change must keep them green. Marking the exercise solved is self-reported.

The starter has a single smoke test (the code under test loads) — green, but it kills no mutant.

Requirements

  • Download the starter (⬇ Starter) and copy its files into your labflow-lite project — the one you have been building since lesson 0.2. It contains the test file to write (test/integration/myBookings.int.test.js), the course version of the code under test, and cham-tai-may.mjs.
  • Write your tests in test/integration/myBookings.int.test.js (more test files are fine: node cham-tai-may.mjs <file…>).
  • Run node cham-tai-may.mjs with Docker running (do not set TEST_DATABASE_URL — every run needs a fresh database). It prints 7/7 when every mutant is killed and the harmless changes stay green.
  • Then press Self-mark as solved. The website cannot verify this — it is your own word.

starterCodeJson.code:
-- LabFlow Lite — PostgreSQL schema (Chapter 4). Applied fresh before every integration run.
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS btree_gist;   -- lets "lab WITH =" join a GiST exclusion constraint

CREATE TABLE bookings (
  id         serial PRIMARY KEY,
  lab        text    NOT NULL,
  date       date    NOT NULL,
  start_time time    NOT NULL,
  end_time   time    NOT NULL,
  seats      int     NOT NULL CHECK (seats > 0),
  role       text    NOT NULL,
  status     text    NOT NULL,
  minutes    int     NOT NULL,
  email      text,
  user_id    text,              -- Chapter 11: who booked it (My bookings)
  -- BR-04 in the database: no two bookings of one lab may overlap. Bounds [) = the end minute is free.
  CONSTRAINT no_overlap EXCLUDE USING gist (
    lab WITH =,
    tsrange(date + start_time, date + end_time, '[)') WITH &&
  ) WHERE (status <> 'CANCELLED')   -- Chapter 11: a cancelled booking frees its slot
);

CREATE INDEX bookings_by_user ON bookings (user_id, date, start_time);   -- Chapter 11: GET /api/bookings

mistakesJson.loi: Testing only typical values in the middle of a range — the correct code and an off-by-one mutant agree there, so the mutant survives.|||Chỉ test giá trị điển hình giữa khoảng — code đúng và đột biến lệch một đơn vị cho cùng kết quả nên đột biến sống.

Forgetting await on an async call or on expect(...).rejects — the test finishes before the promise and stays green whatever the code does.|||Quên await lời gọi async hoặc expect(...).rejects — test kết thúc trước promise và xanh bất kể code làm gì.

Asserting HOW the code does it (call order, internal fields, exact implementation) — a harmless refactor turns such a test red.|||Khẳng định CÁCH code làm (thứ tự gọi, trường nội bộ, cài đặt cụ thể) — một refactor vô hại làm test như vậy đỏ.

Your project’s copy of the code differs from the course version — the local grader then cannot plant the bug (“found 0 times”). Copy the files from the starter.|||Bản code trong dự án của bạn khác bản của khoá — máy chấm cục bộ không cài được lỗi ("found 0 times"). Chép các tệp từ code khởi đầu.
